property_summary: For any caller who is the contract owner, calling updateRoundImplementation succeeds and updates roundImplementation; the mutant treats only the zero address as owner so some valid owner callers will be unable to update and the stored roundImplementation will differ.
change_summary: Change the owner check to compare against zero address instead of msg.sender, so only zero address is treated as owner; this affects who can call updateRoundImplementation and thus observable roundImplementation.
